changes_made.explanation: Consolidated the guideline descriptions into two clear statements and normalized the criteria to three main categories: Semantic Preservation, Grammaticality, and Adversarialness.

overall_notes: This paper primarily focuses on adversarial text generation and evaluation, with strong emphasis on using word-level sensitivities to improve adversarial attacks. The NLG component involves generating paraphrased/perturbed sentences to attack text classifiers. Human evaluation was conducted on 100 unique adversarial paraphrases with clear evaluation criteria. The automatic metrics focus on attack effectiveness rather than traditional NLG quality metrics.
